verdict.rationale: Supermemory ingests raw conversations and auto-extracts memories, then exposes them via hybrid search, memory graph traversal, and always-ready user profiles that update as users interact — this gives an agent a way to recall prior conversation context and continue it (docs-1, docs-2, docs-3, docs-15, docs-23, docs-33). However there is no explicit 'session/thread summary' artifact or transcript-resume feature documented, and no hands-on/independent evidence of an agent actually resuming a specific thread using this data. Missing for 10: a dedicated session-summary or thread-resume API/feature, and independent verification that agents successfully pick up prior conversations using this context.
